      We aim to improve upon the current upper bound for the Erds minimum overlap problem by developing a more sophisticated optimization algorithm. The core idea is to use a combination of constrained optimization techniques and informed candidate generation to escape local optima. Unlike the previous method that relies on random perturbations, our approach systematically explores the solution space through multiple phases: an initial phase to find diverse local optima, a refinement phase to improve these optima, and a continuation phase that persistently pushes the solution to lower C5 values.    2. Mathematical specification
      We represent the function h as a vector of n_point samples on [0,2] with equal spacing. The integral discretization uses dx = 2/n_points.

      • Constraints: 0 <= h[i] <= 1 for all i and sum(h) = n_points/2.
      • Objective function calculation: Compute the full correlation of h and 1-h, then take the maximum value and multiply by dx.
